messages:
maria: Heads up — vendor flagged a 2-week delay on the H100 tranche tied to PO-98321. They offered a partial ship of 32/40 and RMA for the remaining 8. Can EU edge capacity absorb this?

sam: Which region exactly? EU-west or NL edge pool? If it's NL we lose ~12% dedicated throughput. Might need to throttle batch jobs or borrow from reserves.

maria: NL pool. Impact window looks like next two weeks. We should decide split-ship vs wait.

vendor_contact: We can split. Proposed: ship 32 units now (ETA 2026-05-10), hold 8 for RMA/inspection. RMA labels + processing included. Surcharge for split AWB / rework: $1,200 per AWB. AWB: TRACK-PAK-98321.

oliver: @vendor_contact pls confirm depot address we should use for RMA returns and whether customs paperwork will be consolidated on the first AWB or separate. Need serial list before manifest.

vendor_contact: RMA depot: FRA-DEPO-9, will send manifest + serlist in next email. Customs: we'll provide consolidated commercial invoice covering full PO; split AWBs will reference same invoice number but separate house B/L.

vendor_freight_bot: Automated note: earliest dock slot for split-air is 2026-05-09. Extra handling flagged (HAZ/FRAG) — add 24h for palletization.

tim: If we accept split ship, ops needs 4 loaners from APAC reserve to keep canaries green while the 8 are processed. Network: cross-region egress for those loaners will need temporary VPC peering; estimate config + certs ~3h. Any objections to that plan?

sam: Good call. Approve borrowing 4 from APAC reserve as a stopgap. @oliver to confirm peering window.

oliver: I'll open a peering ticket and tag infra-oncall. ETA to complete: 4 hours once we have approval. Also need final serials by EOD to prep depot paperwork.

maria: Ok — plan: accept split ship, pay $1,200 AWB surcharge, request vendor to prioritize manifest + serials today, and ops to provision 4 APAC loaners with peering. @vendor_contact send proforma for surcharge and final ETA. :thumbsup:

vendor_contact: Will send proforma and serial list within 2 business hours. RMA SLA: 7-10 business days after units arrive at FRA depot.

maria: Thanks — I'll update the runbook and notify customers with a short blast about reduced capacity on NL pool for the next 10 days.

sam: Ping me if vendor_proforma doesn't arrive within 3h, I'll escalate.

vendor_freight_bot: Manifest email queued to vendor_contact@forwarder.example.com (ref TRACK-PAK-98321).
